one-piece-open: One open bin with a flat, full-width rear wall and a recessed finger grip.
one-piece-left-right: A straight divider forms two long lanes in a flat-back drawer.
one-piece-front-back: A transverse divider forms a front and a rear compartment.
dry-ends: Four independent rim feet sit at the outside ends of the base.
base-mount: A shared foot at each rim supports the two neighboring cores.
upper-mount: Three curved seats grip the rims where staggered cores meet.
middle-mount: A wood screw fixes the rear junction to the plywood. The front junction grips its own rim.
top-tier: An upper junction and rear screw tab locate an anchored top core.
top-clips: The rear tab screws to plywood. The shallow front keeper presses onto the opposite rim.
core: Reused spool tube, not printed. This example uses nominal 83 mm ID × 88 mm OD × 60 mm length.
wood-screw: A #8 × ¾″ pan-head wood screw through the rear tab fastens it to the plywood. The shelf supports the bank.
triangle-pocket: Small flat-back tray between three cores.
triangle-pocket-frame: Independent front and rear frames stay on the rims as the pocket slides out.
left-pocket: Wide flat-back bin in the left half gap.
left-pocket-frame: Independent front and rear frames stay on the rims as the pocket slides out.
right-pocket: Wide flat-back bin in the right half gap.
right-pocket-frame: Independent front and rear frames stay on the rims as the pocket slides out.
